description: Step 1 of 3 (claim, verify, order): adds your product's domain. An account email on the domain (or a subdomain or parent of it) verifies it at once, unless the domain is one where anyone can get an address (a mailbox provider's, or ours: agentdrives.com, matfy.com) and queues its free check (private); pending then says why your address didn't. Otherwise it returns the ways to prove it: a code mailed to any address at the domain, a DNS TXT record, a meta tag on the home page or a file at /.well-known/agentdrive-verify.txt (the code: send_claim_code).
name: claim_domain
